name: Cross-Site Scripting Testing
description: Identification and exploitation of cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities including reflected, stored, and DOM-based variants. Covers context-aware payload crafting, CSP bypass, filter evasion, and impact demonstration.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands XSS concepts and the three main variants
evidence: Can explain reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS
Understands output encoding and its role in XSS prevention

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Detects basic XSS under supervision; crafts simple payloads
evidence: Identified XSS in lab environments across HTML, attribute, and JavaScript contexts
Performed supervised XSS testing on at least 2 engagements
Findings reviewed and confirmed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently identifies XSS across contexts and demonstrates impact
evidence: Crafts context-appropriate payloads (HTML, JS, attribute, URL contexts)
Demonstrates realistic impact (session hijacking, credential theft) in proof-of-concept
Passed proficiency assessment for XSS identification and exploitation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Bypasses filters and CSP; identifies DOM-based XSS via source analysis
evidence: Demonstrated CSP bypass techniques in engagements
Identifies DOM-based XSS through JavaScript source review
Develops custom XSS payloads for complex filter evasion
Mentors junior testers on XSS methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on client-side injection; discovers novel vectors
evidence: Published research or CVEs related to XSS or client-side injection
Developed lab XSS testing methodology and training materials
Discovers novel injection vectors in modern frameworks (React, Angular, Vue)
Trains teams on advanced client-side attack techniques

assessment_methods.description: Identify and exploit XSS in a prepared application with various output contexts and filtering
Review of XSS findings and proof-of-concept quality from recent engagements
